text:
zoe: Heads-up — drafting the internal release blurb for tomorrow's small deploy (v2.20.0). Ops wants a single copy/paste block + explicit canary cadence + rollback steps.

hank: Keep it compact: four short bullets (what, impact, action, rollback) + one-line embargo note. Ops will paste directly into #deploys.

oliver: Draft below. Please check metrics wording and abort thresholds.

oliver: • What: rate-limit window tuning and safe backoff for inference SDK (flag: infra.rate.backoff_v2).
• Impact: reduces transient 429s and smooths p95 spikes for bursty clients; estimated ~5-8% p95 improvement. No DB/analytics changes.
• Action: /deploy --env staging --tag v2.20.0 --canary 5 (20m) -> 25 (40m) -> prod. Toggle: Console > Feature Flags > infra.rate.backoff_v2. Pin: v2.20.0.
• Rollback: disable infra.rate.backoff_v2 + deploy tag v2.19.8 if error rate rises >0.4% absolute or p95 latency regresses >15% for 20m.

sre-oncall: Oncall: @sre-oncall. I'll be watching 429s, error rate, and host CPU. If I post :rotating_light: we abort immediately.

hank: Add the deploy snippet for ops channel (copy/paste).

oliver: Snippet:
```
/deploy --env staging --tag v2.20.0 --canary 5
# after 20m: /deploy --env staging --tag v2.20.0 --canary 25
# after 40m: /deploy --env prod --tag v2.20.0
```

legal-bot: Confirmed: "No new customer PII or telemetry exported; changes only touch transient rate-limit behavior."

comms: Also need embargo line for internal newsletter. Suggest: "Internal embargo: do not share externally until T+1h after prod ramp."

zoe: Final internal blurb (ready to paste into #deploys):
"""
:zap: What: rate-limit window tuning + safe backoff (flag: infra.rate.backoff_v2).
:bar_chart: Impact: ~5-8% p95 improvement for bursty clients; smooths 429 spikes. No DB or analytics schema changes.
:wrench: Action: /deploy --env staging --tag v2.20.0 --canary 5 (20m) -> 25 (40m) -> prod. Enable via Console > Feature Flags > infra.rate.backoff_v2. Version pin: v2.20.0.
:rotating_light: Rollback: disable infra.rate.backoff_v2 + deploy v2.19.8 if error rate +0.4% absolute OR p95 +15% sustained for 20m.
:link: Dashboards: p95 / 429s / hosts (links will be added in-thread).
:person_with_turban: Oncall: @sre-oncall
Internal embargo: do not share externally until T+1h after prod ramp.
"""

hank: I'll paste dashboards and pin after deploy-bot posts status.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks passed. Deploy job queued: id=1945678901 env=staging tag=v2.20.0 canary=5%. Use `/deploy status 1945678901` to follow logs.

zoe: Thanks team — saving final blurb to release-notes repo after the post.
